items.caption:
Do dreams replay your day? Pieces, not reruns.
In a 2003 study, about 65% of 299 dream reports reflected recent life, yet whole replays were 1 to 2%. A 2011 study found echoes from the day before and from 5 to 7 days before.

items.caption:
Freddy Krueger was inspired by a true story.
In the early 1980s, US officials recorded unexplained deaths in sleep among young refugee men, mostly Hmong. Wes Craven said news of them inspired the film.

items.caption:
This seal sleeps while sinking.
Brain recordings of wild northern elephant seals showed short naps deep in their dives, drifting down in a spiral: about 2 hours of sleep a day at sea, about 10 on land.
